processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik: The practice among us concerning slaves is that when a slave is killed intentionally or by mistake, then his master comes with one witness, he swears an oath along with his witness a single oath, then he receives the value of his slave. There is no qasama (oath-taking procedure) for slaves in intentional or mistaken killing, and I have not heard anyone from the people of knowledge say that. Malik said: If a slave is killed intentionally or by mistake, there is no qasama or oath upon the master of the killed slave, and his master does not deserve that except with just testimony, or with a witness and then he swears with his witness. Yahya said: Malik said: This is the best of what I have heard.

processed_hadiths.arabicText: @ قَالَ /22 يَحْيَى /22 : قَالَ /12 مَالِكٌ /12 : /10 الأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا فِي الْعَبِيدِ ، أَنَّهُ إِذَا أُصِيبَ الْعَبْدُ عَمْدًا أَوْ خَطَأً ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ سَيِّدُهُ بِشَاهِدٍ ، حَلَفَ مَعَ شَاهِدِهِ يَمِينًا وَاحِدَةً ، ثُمَّ كَانَ لَهُ قِيمَةُ عَبْدِهِ ، وَلَيْسَ فِي الْعَبِيدِ قَسَامَةٌ فِي عَمْدٍ أَوْ خَطَأً ، وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ قَالَ ذَلِكَ /10 . قَالَ مَالِكٌ : /10 فَإِنْ قُتِلَ الْعَبْدُ عَمْدًا أَوْ خَطَأً ، لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَى سَيِّدِ الْعَبْدِ الْمَقْتُولِ قَسَامَةً وَلا يَمِينٌ ، وَلا يَسْتَحِقُّ سَيِّدُهُ ذَلِكَ إِلا بِبَيِّنَةٍ عَادِلَةٍ ، أَوْ بِشَاهِدٍ فَيَحْلِفُ مَعَ شَاهِدِهِ /10 . قَالَ يَحْيَى : قَالَ مَالِكٌ : /10 وَهَذَا أَحْسَنُ مَا سَمِعْتُ /10

processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي /22 يَحْيَى بْن يَحْيَى /22 ، قَالَ : حَدَّثَنِي /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 إِسْحَاق بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ L952 /94 ، /27 عَنْ /93 أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ L720 /93 ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : /20 " اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مِكْيَالِهِمْ ، وَبَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي صَاعِهِمْ وَمُدِّهِمْ " /27 ، يَعْنِي أَهْلَ /60 الْمَدِينَةِ /60

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah: The people, when they saw the first fruits, would bring them to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. When the Messenger of Allah ﷺ took them, he would say: 'O Allah, bless us in our fruits, and bless us in our city, and bless us in our Sa', and bless us in our Mudd. O Allah, indeed Ibrahim is Your slave, Your intimate friend, and Your prophet, and indeed I am Your slave and Your prophet. And indeed he called upon You for Mecca, and indeed I call upon You for Medina with the like of what he called upon You for Mecca, and its like with it.' Then he would call the youngest child he saw and give him that fruit.

processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي /22 يَحْيَى /22 ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ L3687 /94 ، عَنْ /26 أَبِيهِ L2840 /26 ، /27 عَنْ /93 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ L4396 /93 ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : كَانَ النَّاسُ إِذَا رَأَوْا أَوَّلَ الثَّمَرِ جَاءُوا بِهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَإِذَا أَخَذَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، قَالَ : /20 " اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا ، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا ، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا ، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مُدِّنَا ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ /56 إِبْرَاهِيمَ /56 عَبْدُكَ وَخَلِيلُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ ، وَإِنِّي عَبْدُكَ وَنَبِيُّكَ ، وَإِنَّهُ دَعَاكَ /60 لِمَكَّةَ /60 وَإِنِّي أَدْعُوكَ /60 لِلْمَدِينَةِ /60 بِمِثْلِ مَا دَعَاكَ بِهِ /60 لِمَكَّةَ /60 وَمِثْلَهُ مَعَهُ " ، ثُمَّ يَدْعُو أَصْغَرَ وَلِيدٍ يَرَاهُ فَيُعْطِيهِ ذَلِكَ الثَّمَرَ /27

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abdullah ibn Umar: Yuhannas, the freed slave of al-Zubayr ibn al-Awwam, informed him that he was sitting with Abdullah ibn Umar during the tribulation (fitna), and a freed female slave of his came to greet him. She said: 'I intended to leave, O Abu Abd al-Rahman, the times have become hard upon us.' Abdullah ibn Umar said to her: 'Sit down, O little foolish one, for indeed I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: "No one endures its hardships and difficulties except that I will be an intercessor for him or a witness for him on the Day of Resurrection."'

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Jabir ibn Abdullah: A Bedouin pledged allegiance to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ upon Islam, then the Bedouin was afflicted with fever in Medina. So he came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: 'O Messenger of Allah, cancel my pledge.' But the Messenger of Allah ﷺ refused. Then he came to him and said: 'Cancel my pledge,' but he refused. Then he came to him and said: 'Cancel my pledge,' but he refused. So the Bedouin left, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Indeed, Medina is like the bellows - it expels its impurities and its pure part becomes bright.'

And Sham will be conquered and a people will come eagerly and will take their families and whoever obeys them, while Medina is better for them if they only knew. And Iraq will be conquered and a people will come eagerly and will take their families and whoever obeys them, while Medina is better for them if they only knew.'

processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ L8055 /94 ، عَنْ /26 أَبِيهِ L5594 /26 ، عَنْ /26 عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ L4697 /26 ، /27 عَنْ /93 سُفْيَانَ بْنِ أَبِي زُهَيْرٍ L3426 /93 ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ : /20 " تُفْتَحُ /60 الْيَمَنُ /60 فَيَأْتِي قَوْمٌ يَبُسُّونَ فَيَتَحَمَّلُونَ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ وَمَنْ أَطَاعَهُمْ ، /60 وَالْمَدِينَةُ /60 خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ، وَتُفْتَحُ /60 الشَّامُ /60 فَيَأْتِي قَوْمٌ يُبِسُّونَ فَيَتَحَمَّلُونَ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ وَمَنْ أَطَاعَهُمْ ، /60 وَالْمَدِينَةُ /60 خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ ، وَتُفْتَحُ /60 الْعِرَاقُ /60 فَيَأْتِي قَوْمٌ يُبِسُّونَ فَيَتَحَمَّلُونَ بِأَهْلِيهِمْ وَمَنْ أَطَاعَهُمْ ، /60 وَالْمَدِينَةُ /60 خَيْرٌ لَهُمْ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ " /27

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Abu Hurayrah: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Medina will surely be left in the best state it has been, until a dog or a wolf enters and urinates on some of the pillars of the mosque or on the minbar.' They said: 'O Messenger of Allah, whose will the fruits be at that time?' He said: 'For the wild animals and beasts - the birds and wild animals.'

processed_hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي /22 يَحْيَى /22 ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /94 ابْنِ حِمَاسٍ L8622 /94 ، عَنْ /26 عَمِّهِ L292 /26 ، /27 عَنْ /93 أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ L4396 /93 ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ : /20 " لَتُتْرَكَنَّ /60 الْمَدِينَةُ /60 عَلَى أَحْسَنِ مَا كَانَتْ ، حَتَّى يَدْخُلَ الْكَلْبُ أَوِ الذِّئْبُ فَيُغَذِّي عَلَى بَعْضِ سَوَارِي الْمَسْجِدِ أَوْ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ " ، فَقَالُوا : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، فَلِمَنْ تَكُونُ الثِّمَارُ ذَلِكَ الزَّمَانَ ؟ قَالَ : " لِلْعَوَافِي : الطَّيْرِ وَالسِّبَاعِ " /27

processed_hadiths.english_translation: When Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz left Medina, he turned towards it and wept, then said: 'O Muzahim, do you fear that we might be among those whom Medina has expelled?'

processed_hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Anas ibn Malik: Uhud appeared to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, so he said: 'This is a mountain that loves us and we love it. O Allah, indeed Ibrahim sanctified Mecca, and I sanctify what is between its two lava fields (Medina).'
